bdd.title: Block definition diagram
bdd.desc: Part definitions and what contains what. Each arrow reads: the whole contains the part, labelled with the part name.
bdd.src:
classDiagram
  direction LR
  class Airframe
  class Motor
  class Rotor
  class TiltActuator
  class PayloadSensor
  class FpvCamera
  class LandingGear
  class Battery {
    port powerOut : PowerOut
  }
  class PowerDistribution {
    port powerIn : PowerIn
    port toLeftNacelle : PowerOut
    port toRightNacelle : PowerOut
    port toFlightController : PowerOut
    port toRadioLink : PowerOut
    port toGimbal : PowerOut
  }
  class FlightController {
    port powerIn : PowerIn
    port pilotCommand : CommandIn
    port tiltCommandLeft : CommandOut
    port tiltCommandRight : CommandOut
    port gimbalCommand : CommandOut
  }
  class RadioLink {
    port powerIn : PowerIn
    port pilotCommand : CommandOut
  }
  class Nacelle {
    port powerIn : PowerIn
    port tiltCommand : CommandIn
  }
  class Gimbal {
    port powerIn : PowerIn
    port gimbalCommand : CommandIn
  }
  class Tiltrotor
  Tiltrotor *-- Airframe : airframe
  Tiltrotor *-- LandingGear : landingGear
  Tiltrotor *-- FpvCamera : fpvCamera
  Tiltrotor *-- Nacelle : leftRotorNacelle
  Tiltrotor *-- Nacelle : rightRotorNacelle
  Tiltrotor *-- Gimbal : noseGimbal
  Tiltrotor *-- Battery : battery
  Tiltrotor *-- PowerDistribution : powerDistribution
  Tiltrotor *-- FlightController : flightController
  Tiltrotor *-- RadioLink : radioLink
  Nacelle *-- Motor : motor
  Nacelle *-- Rotor : rotor
  Nacelle *-- TiltActuator : tiltActuator
  Gimbal *-- PayloadSensor : payloadSensor

ibd.title: Internal block diagram
ibd.desc: Parts of the tiltrotor and the connections between their ports. Thick arrows carry power, thin arrows carry commands. Proposed architecture, to confirm.
ibd.src:
flowchart LR
  subgraph tiltrotor["tiltrotor : Vehicle"]
    airframe["airframe : Airframe"]
    landingGear["landingGear : LandingGear"]
    fpvCamera["fpvCamera : FpvCamera"]
    subgraph leftRotorNacelle["leftRotorNacelle : Nacelle"]
      leftRotorNacelle_motor["motor : Motor"]
      leftRotorNacelle_rotor["rotor : Rotor"]
      leftRotorNacelle_tiltActuator["tiltActuator : TiltActuator"]
    end
    subgraph rightRotorNacelle["rightRotorNacelle : Nacelle"]
      rightRotorNacelle_motor["motor : Motor"]
      rightRotorNacelle_rotor["rotor : Rotor"]
      rightRotorNacelle_tiltActuator["tiltActuator : TiltActuator"]
    end
    subgraph noseGimbal["noseGimbal : Gimbal"]
      noseGimbal_payloadSensor["payloadSensor : PayloadSensor"]
    end
    battery["battery : Battery"]
    powerDistribution["powerDistribution : PowerDistribution"]
    flightController["flightController : FlightController"]
    radioLink["radioLink : RadioLink"]
  end
  battery ==>|"powerOut to powerIn"| powerDistribution
  powerDistribution ==>|"toLeftNacelle to powerIn"| leftRotorNacelle
  powerDistribution ==>|"toRightNacelle to powerIn"| rightRotorNacelle
  powerDistribution ==>|"toFlightController to powerIn"| flightController
  powerDistribution ==>|"toRadioLink to powerIn"| radioLink
  powerDistribution ==>|"toGimbal to powerIn"| noseGimbal
  radioLink -->|"pilotCommand to pilotCommand"| flightController
  flightController -->|"tiltCommandLeft to tiltCommand"| leftRotorNacelle
  flightController -->|"tiltCommandRight to tiltCommand"| rightRotorNacelle
  flightController -->|"gimbalCommand to gimbalCommand"| noseGimbal

state.desc: Allowed transitions between hover, conversion and cruise (VEH-7).

  conversion --> cruise : conversionToCruise

  conversion --> hover : conversionToHover

trace.text: The vehicle shall be a twin-rotor tiltrotor with a gimbal in the nose that carries a replaceable payload sensor, and a separate FPV camera.
The vehicle shall have at least 30 minutes of flight time. Reserve policy to be set.
The vehicle shall be operable under 14 CFR Part 107.
Takeoff mass including payload shall be less than the limit, with a sizing margin to be set.
Operation shall stay below the altitude limit and at or below the groundspeed limit.
Operation shall stay within visual line of sight of the remote pilot.
The vehicle shall convert between hover and cruise inside a conversion corridor to be defined.
The vehicle shall be free of whirl flutter inside the flight envelope, with at least the margin required in the flutter program requirements.
The structure shall carry limit loads without detrimental deformation and ultimate loads without failure, with factors to be set.
The vehicle shall move between flight modes only along the transitions defined in the FlightModes state definition.
Every monitored and controlled variable of the vehicle shall have a unit and range, and every controlled variable shall also have a latency and a tolerance.
